network.quick_switch_content:
When the current service hits network restrictions, you can:

1. **Switch assistants**: Pick another available assistant from the left panel.
2. **Check service status**: Some AI services aren't available in every region.
3. **Use a stable network**: A steadier connection fails less often.
4. **Try again later**: Network restrictions are usually temporary.

**Tip**: Set up more than one AI service so you can keep working when one isn't available.

cloudflare_blocked: • Switch networks (for example, to a mobile hotspot)
• Clear your browser cache and cookies
• Switch to another available service: ChatGPT, Claude, Qwen or Gemini
network_timeout: • Check that your network connection is stable
• Switch to a more stable network
connection_refused: • Check that Codex CLI is installed correctly
• Check the service configuration and API keys
• Check whether the local port is already in use
